Call kvm_vcpu_block() directly for all wait states except HALTED so that
kvm_vcpu_halt() is no longer a misnomer on x86.

column2: this means KVM will never attempt halt-polling or adjust

column1: AP_RESET_HOLD; UNINITIALIZED is handled in kvm_arch_vcpu_ioctl_run()
and x86 doesn't use any other ""wait"" states.

column2: the motivation of this is purely so that ""halt"" isn't
e.g. in KVM's stats.  Skipping halt-polling for WFS

column1: (and RESET_HOLD) has no meaningful effect on guest performance as there
are typically single-digit numbers of INIT-SIPI sequences per AP vCPU

column2: versus thousands of HLTs just to boot to console.
